thread_title: S. minor var. okefenokeensis Camden Co, GA
breadcrumb: S. minor var. okefenokeensis Camden Co, GA

posts.body_html:
Here is a significant, relatively newly discovered population of minors from outside the okefenokee swamp drainage system! The plants I have in cultivation look like they have some psittacina mixed in there at some point, they definitely don't look anything like the other minor giants I've grown before!

Well, this is the start of the thread, will update it as these grow up! S. minor var. okefenokeensis Camden Co, GA, pics taken 8/12/21:

posts.body_html:
Definitely hybrid-ey as F...ugue in D minor! Thing is, this doesn't appear to be a primary hybrid between psittacina nd minor, it looks more like the pollen donor was some sort of minor and psittacina mix. There is one "pure" looking minor in this batch (not shown), but it's still pretty small.

Here are the hybrids, which are actually a bit exciting because these will be great for breeding with other minors. I bet we can make some serious red minor giant clones with these genetics! Pics taken 9/12/22:
